info.name: Unsubscribe from DAM alert emails (human click).

params.name: token
params.description: HMAC-signed unsubscribe token from the email footer link

items.docs: Validates the HMAC token embedded in a DAM alert email's unsubscribe link, removes the recipient from each referenced rule's email_recipients, and returns an HTML confirmation page. Unauthenticated — authorized solely by the signed token.

info.name: Unsubscribe from DAM alert emails (RFC 8058 one-click).

items.docs: One-click unsubscribe for Gmail/Yahoo. The token is supplied in the query string (the List-Unsubscribe URL already carries it); the `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` request body is ignored. Unauthenticated — authorized solely by the signed token. Returns 200 with an empty body.
